displayName: Gov Disclosure Check（政务公开披露校验）
description: Check government disclosure documents for required fields — decision basis, responsible department, response deadline, remedy channel and data source — and list what is missing before publication. gov-disclosure-check — LGD 三律在政务 / 信息公开披露域的纵深合规工具（零依赖）：强制披露字段校验（决策依据/责任部门/时限/救济渠道/数据来源），对 AI 系统/数据做可执行合规校验。
